dispute_ticket.description: I cancelled my 6pm booking before the driver got anywhere near me and the MRT line had broken down, yet I was charged $6.00. Please refund it.

chat_logs.content: Trip cancelled by rider. Advance booking cancellation fee of $6.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-7104 booked advance trip RYDE-F2-004 from Raffles Place MRT to Changi Business Park. Pickup 2026-10-06 18:00.
Driver D-8204 (Teo Chee Seng, Toyota Prius SKB 1188 H) assigned for the 18:00 pickup.
$6.00 advance-booking cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

advance_cancel_free_min_before.text: Minutes before the scheduled pickup time. A rider cancellation of an advance booking made at least this many minutes before the scheduled pickup time (scheduled time minus cancellation time) is free; a cancellation made fewer minutes before is charged. Exactly this many minutes counts as free.

advance_cancellation_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when an advance booking is cancelled inside the free window. It governs rider-side cancellations only.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Ryde may refund a fee that is otherwise due only when a fault on Ryde's side (app, matching or driver conduct) contributed to the cancellation.

expected_outcome.reason: The booking was for 18:00:00 and the rider cancelled at 17:46:00 (rider_cancelled event), 14 minutes before pickup. This trip's policy makes the cancellation free only at 15 minutes or more before the scheduled time, so the S$6.00 fee is due. The driver's position (about 5 km away, still en route) and the MRT disruption are not Ryde-side faults, and the discretion rule requires one. The fee stands.
